description: Dry-run a press5.game.json: returns ok, the room type (relay or server engine), every error with its path and the exact fix, warnings (for example a relay game with no anti-cheat "guard" block), the engine settings with defaults filled in, and next steps. Call it before deploy_site for any multiplayer game. JSON Schema: https://my.press5.xyz/schemas/press5.game.json. No account needed.
